content.text: The failure is the nested-island boundary: `Hero client:load` owns the React island, so the `client:only` child is treated as slot content rather than an independently mounted Astro island. I’ll remove the parent hydration directive so Astro can process the demo as its own island while preserving the existing Hero markup and slot layout.
